mapper.select: SELECT code, name, normalized_name, region, aliases::text AS aliases, latitude, longitude, dataset_version, is_active, created_at FROM provinces WHERE is_active = TRUE AND dataset_version = #{datasetVersion} ORDER BY code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provinces WHERE is_active = TRUE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_places, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE province_code IS NOT NULL) AS assigned_places, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE province_status = 'AMBIGUOUS') AS ambiguous_places, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL) AS places_with_coordinates, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE province_code IS NOT NULL AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL) AS assigned_places_with_coordinates FROM places

SELECT id, title, address, latitude, longitude, province_code, province_confidence FROM places WHERE province_status = 'AMBIGUOUS' ORDER BY province_confidence DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET province_code = #{provinceCode}, province_status = #{status}, province_confidence = #{confidence}, province_assigned_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{placeId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, address, latitude, longitude FROM places WHERE province_code IS NULL AND (province_status IS NULL OR province_status = 'PENDING') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO passport_events (id, user_id, source, source_id, place_id, checkin_id, location_key, location_name, province_code, occurred_at, is_verified, is_hidden, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{source}, #{sourceId}, #{placeId}, #{checkinId}, #{locationKey}, #{locationName}, #{provinceCode}, #{occurredAt}, #{isVerified}, #{isHidden}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (source, source_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM passport_events WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE passport_events SET is_hidden = #{hidden} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS checkin_id, c.user_id, c.checked_in_at, c.lat, c.lng, a.name AS location_name, p.id AS place_id, p.province_code AS province_code FROM checkins c JOIN activities a ON a.id = c.activity_id -- activities.place_id holds the external identifier, places.id is the internal -- one; the passport event references the internal row. LEFT JOIN places p ON p.place_id = a.place_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM passport_events e WHERE e.source = 'ACTIVITY_CHECKIN' AND e.source_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.checked_in_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_verified) AS verified_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(location_key, place_id::text)) AS distinct_place_count, COUNT(DISTINCT province_code) FILTER (WHERE province_code IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_province_count, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_event_at, MAX(occurred_at) AS last_event_at FROM passport_events WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT province_code FROM passport_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND province_code IS NOT NULL
SELECT province_code AS code, COUNT(*) AS total FROM passport_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND province_code IS NOT NULL AND is_hidden = FALSE GROUP BY province_code
SELECT * FROM passport_stamp_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY threshold, code
SELECT * FROM passport_stamp_rules WHERE code = #{code} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO passport_stamps (id, user_id, rule_code, rule_version, triggering_event_id, awarded_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{ruleCode}, #{ruleVersion}, #{triggeringEventId}, #{awardedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, rule_code, rule_version) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM passport_stamps WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY awarded_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO passport_province_wishes (user_id, province_code) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provinceCode}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, province_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM passport_province_wishes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND province_code = #{provinceCode}
mapper.select: SELECT province_code FROM passport_province_wishes WHERE user_id = #{userId}
